title: Claude Sonnet and Opus change routes
summary:
Claude’s routing and request handling got attention, OpenCode gained a configuration installer, and ChatPUA joined the app catalog.

`claude` and `claude-large` were moved from AWS Bedrock to Google Vertex AI to address token-rate limits. `claude-fast` remains on Bedrock. The same PR added Oh My Pollicode, an installer that configures Pollinations models for OpenCode and oh-my-opencode.

The Vertex AI configurations now return OpenAI-style string content to address response-validation errors. They also supply a 64,000-token default when `max_tokens` is omitted, while still accepting a value supplied by the caller.

Libre-Connect’s bilingual iOS roleplay chat app was added to the app catalog and README’s recent apps list.

highlights.title: Pollinations setup for OpenCode
highlights.text: Oh My Pollicode installs OpenCode and oh-my-opencode and writes Pollinations provider and multi-agent model configuration to your OpenCode config.
